toigo_round_glasses_leopard.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_round_glasses_leopard.description: This is a pair of round glasses with gradient tint lenses. They were designed for adult female humans but will go on others with just a little scaling of the Y and/or X axes in edit mode. There are seven other colors available in the materials section. Glasses model Sarah is also wearing punkduck's Deathnote T-shirt.
